title: Single-cell mapping of regulatory DNA-protein interactions.
authors: Chi, Wei-Yu; Yoon, Sang-Ho; Goksel, Evrim; Mekerishvili, Levan; Pelt, Joe; Lin, Yiyun; Prieto, Tamara; Zinno, John; Ganesan, Saravanan; Potenski, Catherine; Izzo, Franco; Landau, Dan A; Raimondi, Ivan
one_liner_zh: 该文开发单细胞免疫锚定测序技术D&D-seq，通过胞嘧啶碱基编辑检测弱/瞬时TF-DNA结合，虽为实验方法但聚焦TF-DNA互作且可整合多组学，对课题有参考价值。
abstract: Gene expression is controlled by transcription factors (TFs), whose genome binding is shaped by chromatin accessibility and histone modifications, yet mapping these interactions, particularly those with weak affinity or a transient nature, in single cells remains technically challenging. To address this gap, we developed docking and deamination followed by sequencing (D&D-seq), a single-cell immuno-tethering technology for profiling DNA-protein interactions. D&D-seq couples an antibody-binding nanobody to a cytosine base editor, a combination that enables detection of weak or transient factor binding through targeted cytosine-to-uracil editing at protein-bound genomic sites. This approach is compatible with standard single-cell multi-omic workflows and therefore allows integrated analyses of gene regulation. Using assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-seq) and single-cell ATAC-seq (scATAC-seq), we assessed chromatin accessibility as a functional readout of TF activity, and by coupling D&D-seq with whole-genome sequencing, we captured CTCF binding in both active and inactive chromatin compartments.
abstract_zh: 基因表达受转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）调控，其基因组结合受染色质可及性和组蛋白修饰影响，然而在单细胞水平上绘制这些相互作用，特别是弱亲和力或瞬时性的相互作用，在技术上仍具挑战。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了对接与脱氨后测序（docking and deamination followed by sequencing, D&D-seq），一种用于分析DNA-蛋白质相互作用的单细胞免疫锚定技术。D&D-seq将抗体结合纳米抗体与胞嘧啶碱基编辑器偶联，该组合通过靶向胞嘧啶至尿嘧啶编辑在蛋白质结合基因组位点实现弱或瞬时因子结合的检测。该方法与标准单细胞多组学工作流程兼容，因此可进行基因调控的整合分析。利用转座酶可及染色质测序（assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing, ATAC-seq）和单细胞ATAC-seq（scATAC-seq），我们评估了染色质可及性作为TF活性的功能读数，并通过将D&D-seq与全基因组测序结合，捕获了活性及非活性染色质区室中的CTCF结合。
